context: Sho-young describes a colorful bug he saw to Mei.
purpose: Child sharing nature observation with mother.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、茶色の虫、見た!
lines.en: Mom — I saw a brown bug!
lines.style: Breathless excitement on the opening. High, open vowels. Fast delivery, tumbling over words in eagerness to share. Alive with wonder at having made a discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Warm and attentive, voice lifting slightly with genuine curiosity. Soft pace. Matching his energy without overshadowing it — drawing him in to tell more.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 乗り物みたいに、ようけ速く飛ぶ!
lines.en: It flies really fast — like a little vehicle!
lines.style: Quick, animated delivery matching his motion observation. Slight rise in pitch and pace. Small pause before 'vehicle' to let the image land. Genuine delight in the comparison.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 機嫌、良さそうね、あなた。
lines.en: You're in such a good mood today.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Almost thinking aloud, but warm. A slight smile audible beneath the words. Not commenting on him — recognizing something private and gentle in him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 優しく、見守ってた、心、温かい!
lines.en: My heart feels warm watching you like this.
lines.style: Tender, almost whispered. Slow pace. The words carry weight without rushing them. A moment of connection — she's speaking more to herself than to him, but letting him hear it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: It's been such a fun day.
lines.style: Light, easy, almost to herself. A small laugh woven in. The satisfaction of a moment shared and held. Gentle trailing-off, like she's savoring the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, I want to see it again!
lines.style: Bright, determined, hopeful. Forward momentum in the delivery. The certainty of childhood — absolute conviction that the bug will return and he'll watch for it. Eager but not frantic.
